?Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc:145096
Court No. - 70
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 17201 of 2022

Applicant :- Smt. Gopa Devi @ Gopal Devi
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.

Counsel for Applicant :- Harish Chandra Pratap,Rajiv Shukla
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Satya Narayan Yadav
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.

1 .  Heard Ms. Monika Pal, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Satya Narayan Yadav, learned counsel for the informant and Sri Pradeep Kumar, learned AGA for the State.
2.

The instant bail application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No. 432 of 2021, under Sections 498A, 304B IPC and 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Jasrana, District Firozabad during pendency of the trial.

3. FIR of the present case was lodged against applicant and her family members including husband of the deceased and according to the FIR marriage of the son of the applicant was performed with the deceased on 31.05.2020 and after marriage applicant and his family members tortured her for Rs. 7 lakhs to buy four wheeler car and on 30.10.2021 applicant and his family members committed the murder of the deceased for want of dowry.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that applicant is mother-in-law of the deceased and entire allegation of demand of dowry and harassment made against her is totally false and baseless.

sentences.text: She further submits that applicant was not having any concern with the family affairs of the deceased and it appears that some dispute arose between husband and wife and thereafter wife committed suicide.
She further submits that post mortem report of the deceased suggests that she died due to hanging and her hyoid bone was found intact.

She further submits, however, apart from the ligature mark autopsy surgeon also noted three contusions on her leg and thigh and it appears that during the process of commission of suicide she sustained these injuries.
5. She further submits that applicant is lady and she is in jail since 26.11.2021 i.e. for more than one and half years.

6. Per contra, learned AGA and learned counsel for the informant opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that daughter-in-law of the applicant died within one year of her marriage under abnormal circumstances in her matrimonial home and there is also allegation of demand of dowry but they could not dispute that applicant is mother-in-law and there is no specific allegation against her either in the FIR or in the statements of witnesses recorded during investigation and as per autopsy surgeon deceased died due to hanging and her hyoid bone was found intact.
7. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

8. Applicant is mother-in-law of the deceased and her daughter-in-law died under abnormal circumstances within one year of her marriage and there is also allegation of demand of dowry but there is no specific allegation against the applicant and argument advanced by learned counsel for the applicant that due to the dispute arose between husband and wife, deceased committed suicide cannot be ruled out at this stage as even as per autopsy surgeon she died due to hanging and her hyoid bone was found intact.
9.

Although, from the perusal of the post mortem report it appears that deceased also sustained three minor contusions on her leg and thigh but at this stage it cannot be ruled out that while committing suicide she might have sustained these minor contusions.
10. Further, applicant is lady and she is in jail since for more than one and half years.

11. Therefore, considering the facts and circumstances of the case discussed above, in my view,
applicant, who is mother-in-law, is entitled to be released on bail.
12. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

13. Let the applicant - Smt. Gopa Devi @ Gopal Devi be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.

sentences.text: (ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
14. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.

15. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.
